title: Do Language Models Mirror Human Confidence? Exploring Psychological Insights to Address Overconfidence in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Expected Calibration Error (ECE) between the model's self-estimated confidence and actual accuracy across QA tasks of varying difficulty to measure overconfidence.
Prompting models to adopt personas with varying levels of expertise (e.g., expert, layman) and measuring the gap between their estimated confidence and actual accuracy (overplacement).
Prompting models to adopt personas of different genders (Male, Female, Non-binary) and measuring the gap between their estimated confidence and actual accuracy.
Prompting models to adopt personas of different races (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) and measuring the gap between their estimated confidence and actual accuracy.
Prompting models to adopt personas of different age groups (18-24, 25-39, 40-54, 55+) and measuring the gap between their estimated confidence and actual accuracy.
